components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.description: Main action button used across hero section and primary form submits.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.25); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #1d4ed8; transform: translateY(-1px); }

narrative.overview: JobPilot combines the precision of an aviator's flight deck with high-density modern SaaS design, featuring subtle background dot grid patterns, glassmorphism containers, and vibrant status pills.

rules.name: The Single Accent Focus Rule
rules.body: Vibrant blue (#2563EB) is reserved strictly for primary interactive triggers, active filters, and key score highlights.

rules.name: The Flat-With-Border Rule
rules.body: Containers rest flat on the dot grid canvas with precision 1px border strokes; elevation shadows appear only on hover.

dos: Do maintain the subtle dot-grid canvas pattern across all page layouts.
Do preserve high contrast between text labels and score badge backgrounds.
Do keep skeleton loading states structured to match exact resolved components.
donts: Don't use heavy drop shadows or solid dark borders in light mode.
Don't mix plain browser default fonts with custom Tailwind typography.
